verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents an official WC-CLI for managing stores from the command line, with docs corroborated by a live probe hit at developer.woocommerce.com/docs/category/wc-cli/. This satisfies the CLI story, though it's not explicitly framed as 'AI-native' (that's covered by the separate MCP support). Missing for 10: independent hands-on usage reports of the CLI, and no explicit AI-native workflow examples using the CLI itself.
